_meta.notes: Every string the interface says in its own voice, in one file so the copy budget can be linted. Templates use {braces}. Keep each under its cap in engine/copy-budget.js.

chrome.glossaryAria: Words: what the letters and terms on this site mean
chrome.firstRun: Nothing here can be closed to you.
chrome.subjectsHint: Tap a level. Tap again to undo.
chrome.perfHead: What it asks for at the end
chrome.perfNote: This app does not know your grades and never guesses them.
chrome.askHead: Take one question to a person
chrome.levelsMove: Levels move. Students change them every year.
chrome.shareHint: Copy the link. It holds your plan and nothing else.
chrome.footer: A thinking tool, not official advice. Check with your ECG counsellor.
chrome.stale: Last checked {days} days ago. Criteria change.
chrome.availDisclaimer: Schools offer different subsets of these.
chrome.availMore: Refer to the combinations your school offers.
chrome.conflictNote: {a} repeats the {b} half of your Humanities pair. Schools ask for a different elective. Worth checking.
chrome.onTimetable: These are on your timetable already. Set them to what you are actually taking.
chrome.horizonNote: A combination like this usually follows. Yours will be your own.
chrome.breadthNudge: Rule things out after you look, not before.
chrome.codeHint: Five characters. Read it out if your teacher asks. It carries no name and no grades, and it cannot be turned back into you.

pulse.removed: {subject} off the list. {dest} still has a road in.
pulse.noChange: {subject} at {level}. Nothing shifted, and that is normal.
pulse.allOpen: All eight open. Which two years do you actually want?
pulse.rest: Two are open before you pick anything.

load.heavy: That is a heavy load. Four done well beats seven done thinly, at every admission point.
load.solid: A normal load. Is there one in there you took for the look of it?
load.spread: A balanced spread. Depth usually serves people better than a thin layer.
load.early: Still early. Check you have not ruled out something you never tried.

ask.move: Ask your {who}: what would it take to move my {subject} up?
ask.dest: Ask your ECG counsellor: what is {dest} actually like day to day?
ask.aim: Ask an adult who does this: what are the bad days like?
ask.open: Ask your form teacher: which of these would suit how I learn?

thisYear.sec1: Four subjects can move up at the end of this year. Asking is the whole mechanism.
thisYear.sec2: The big one. Where your levels land this year is what you carry into Sec 3.
thisYear.sec3: Your levels are largely set. What you build with them this year is not.
thisYear.sec4: Early Admissions opens before results. What you have made and done counts now.
thisYear.sec5: This year widens what comes next. Aim it at something specific.

journey.wantPrompt: Before you start. What do you want by 25?
journey.wantHint: You can change your mind later. People do.
journey.asks: You need {disp} for this. You have {have}.
journey.stretchChip: a stretch for you right now
journey.recapHint: You played this part before. Keep it or change it.
journey.endWantUnsure: At {age} you said you were not sure yet. That was honest, and it worked.
journey.compareCta: Put two stories side by side
journey.verdict: Same start, different choices. Neither story is the wrong one. Your starting point set the first step. It did not write the rest.
journey.comboPrompt: Play forward from the subjects you are taking.
journey.comboNote: This is where your story starts. It is not where it ends.
journey.comboGate: Pick subjects above, or just start.
journey.comboSheet: Tap a level. Nothing here is final, and you can change it any time.
journey.verdictCombo: Different subjects, different first steps, and you are both holding doors. The combination started the story. It did not finish it.
journey.q2: Where do I want to go?
journey.railWhereNone: Not sure yet. Most people are not.
journey.stillTrueNone: At {age} you said you were not sure what you wanted.
journey.efficacyLine: You did the hard one. Now you know you can.
journey.ikigaiLine: This story filled {a} most. The next years are for {b}.
journey.ikigaiNote: Almost nobody has all four at your age. They fill up as you go.
journey.kindsNote: Six kinds of people at work. Most people are a mix of two or three.
journey.tryContrast: You played {a}. Try the opposite kind of life:
journey.turnHint: You get points for your time this year. Spend them on what you do. Asking people is free. Pick what you want, then tap Live this year.
journey.leftHint: 1 point left. Add one more, or live the year now.
journey.startOverArm: Tap again. This story will be gone.
journey.handRule: Asking is free. Two a year. Ask one person and you find out who else to ask.
journey.handEmpty: You have asked everyone in your hand.
journey.handUsed: You asked two people this year.
journey.whyFull: Seven subjects or more is a fuller year.
journey.whyLight: A lighter subject load leaves room.
journey.whyCca: The club you went all in on takes its share.
journey.whyFreer: More of your time is yours to direct now.
journey.whyWeek: Your week outside lessons is a full one.
journey.whyRoom: There is room in your week outside lessons.
journey.whyNote: This is about the hours in your year, not about whether your combination is right.
journey.staleBody: This story is still playing the {old} you started with. Stories keep the subjects they began with, so the one you already played stays true.
journey.staleFresh: Start fresh with my new subjects
journey.staleYear: You were {old} when this story started. You are {new} now.
journey.yearNoWant: You have not named what you want yet. That is allowed, and this still counts.
journey.undoNote: Changed your mind? Put it back the way it was.
journey.runPick: How far do you want to play?
journey.runLongNote: Fifteen years. Takes longer, and shows more.
journey.tourHead: Three things and you are playing
journey.tour1: Points are your time this year. Big choices cost 2, small ones cost 1.
journey.tour2: People you can ask are free. Two a year, and they open things later.
journey.tour3: Pick everything you want, then tap Live this year once.
journey.weekPaidNote: You carried {what} through this year. That happens whether or not a turn is spent on it.

footerDoors.head: This tool has three doors
footerDoors.parents: Parents, a short guide to the system as it is now.
footerDoors.teachers: Teachers, running this with a class.

aim.playedHead: You played a story about this
aim.playedBody: At {age} you wanted this. By 48 you were holding {n} doors, and you became someone {words}.
aim.reachHead: What your subjects reach right now
aim.reachBody: {n} open now, from the combination sitting in Now.
aim.reachNone: Nothing set in Now yet. Set your subjects and this fills in.
aim.movesBody: Real things you can do this year.
aim.chooserLede: Not a job title. A shape of life, and more than one road to it.
aim.saidBody: From the last time you were here. Tick what you have done.

teacher.classIntro: Ask each student for their class code, one line each. Nothing is sent anywhere: this runs in your browser and disappears when you close the tab.
teacher.classPunch: Between you, this room already holds {n} of the {total} destinations.
teacher.classAll: Between you, this room already holds every destination on the list.
teacher.classNote: Nobody here holds all of them alone. That is the point worth saying out loud.
teacher.classNone: No codes yet. Paste them above.

parentLive.head: What is on this phone
parentLive.none: Nothing set on this device yet. The rest of this page still holds.
parentLive.takes: Your child has set {n} subjects for {year}.
parentLive.opens: With those levels, {n} of the {total} next steps are open to them right now.
parentLive.lever: One change would move {n} of them: {move}.
parentLive.privacy: Subjects only. What they wrote, what they wanted, the stories they played and what they said they carry outside lessons stay theirs, and this page does not show them.
parentLive.askBody: Ask them to show you this screen and talk you through it. Not to justify it. Just to show you.
